oromo: Pireezidaanti Traamp, bineensota bosonaa gosa 'grey wolf' fi 'Mexican wolf' jedhaman seera eegumsa bineensota balaa keessa jiran irraa kaasuuf ajaja mallatteessaniiru. Ajajni kun horsiisee bulaan loon isaanii akka hin midhamneef murtoo kana akka gochuuf kan akeekkatedha. Haata'u malee, gareewwan eegumsa naannoo, lakkoofsi bineensota kanaa ammallee guutummaatti hin deebine waan ta'eef, murtoon kun hojii waggoota hedduu mancaasuu danda'a jechuun mormaniiru.

title: LIVE: India vs Pakistan – Women’s T20 Asia Cup
english: The Indian and Pakistani women's cricket teams are competing in a Group A match during the 2026 Women’s T20 Asia Cup. This high-profile game is being hosted at the Dubai International Stadium in the United Arab Emirates. The match is scheduled to begin at 6:30 PM local time.
amharic: የህንድ እና የፓኪስታን የሴቶች የክሪኬት ቡድኖች በ2026 የሴቶች የT20 እስያ ዋንጫ የምድብ ኤ ጨዋታቸውን እያደረጉ ነው። ይህ ታላቅ የክሪኬት ግጥሚያ የሚካሄደው በተባበሩት አረብ ኤሚሬቶች፣ ዱባይ ዓለም አቀፍ ስታዲየም ነው። ጨዋታው በዱባይ ሰዓት አቆጣጠር ከምሽቱ 6:30 ላይ ይጀመራል።
oromo: Gareen kirikeetii dubartoota Hindii fi Paakistaan Waancaa Eeshiyaa T20 bara 2026 keessatti tapha garee A irratti wal-morkachaa jiru. Taphi kun kan gaggeeffamaa jiru dirree istaadiyoomii idil-addunyaa Dubaay kan biyya Emireetota Arabaa Gamtoomaniitti. Taphi kunis yeroo Dubaay sa'aatii 6:30 galgala irratti kan jalqabu ta'a.

title: Mudslide in eastern China kills one, leaves 11 missing
english: A severe mudslide caused by persistent heavy rainfall in China's Jiangxi province has resulted in one death and left 11 people missing. Emergency responders have successfully recovered three survivors from the debris. Authorities continue to caution local residents as the threat of flooding remains high.
amharic: በቻይና ጂያንሺ ግዛት ለቀናት በዘለቀው ከባድ ዝናብ ምክንያት በተፈጠረ የመሬት መንሸራተት አንድ ሰው ህይወቱ ሲያልፍ 11 ሰዎች ደግሞ የት እንደደረሱ አልታወቀም። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች ሶስት ሰዎችን ከጭቃው ስር በህይወት ማውጣት ችለዋል። ባለስልጣናት የጎርፍ አደጋ ስጋት አሁንም ስላለ ህዝቡ ጥንቃቄ እንዲያደርግ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Mootummaa Chaayinaa naannoo Jiangxi keessatti rooba cimaa guyyoota hedduuf robeen mudatee tureen lafti ishee sigigsuun nama tokko ajjeeseera, namoonni 11 immoo bakka buutee isaanii hin beekamu. Gareen gargaarsa hatattamaa namoota sadii gubbee lafaatii lubbuun baasuu danda'aniiru. Bulchiinsi naannichaa sodaan balaa lolaa ammas waan jiruuf ummanni of eeggannoo cimaa akka godhu akeekkachiiseera.

title: At least 5 killed in Russian attacks on Ukraine as US envoys visit Moscow
english: A Russian strike on the Ukrainian city of Kamianske resulted in at least five deaths and several injuries, despite a reported three-day ceasefire intended to allow for diplomatic peace talks. US envoys have arrived in Moscow and Kyiv to propose a plan to end the conflict. Meanwhile, the International Atomic Energy Agency has secured a separate, localized ceasefire to repair power lines at the Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant.
amharic: በዩክሬን ካሚያንኬ ከተማ በደረሰ የሩሲያ ጥቃት ቢያንስ አምስት ሰዎች ሲሞቱ ሌሎች አምስት ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ይህ ጥቃት የተፈጸመው የሰላም ንግግሮችን ለማመቻቸት በተቀመጠ የሶስት ቀን የተኩስ አቁም ጊዜ ውስጥ ቢሆንም ነው። የአሜሪካ ዲፕሎማቶች ጦርነቱን ለማስቆም በሞስኮ እና በኪየቭ ጉብኝት እያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ በተመሳሳይ የኑክሌር ጣቢያን የኤሌክትሪክ መስመር ለመጠገን የተለየ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ተደርጓል።
oromo: Magaalaa Yukreen Kaamiyaankee keessatti haleellaa Raashiyaan gaggeessiteen namoonni shan yoo du'an, kaan immoo miidhamaniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame yeroo lolli dhaabbachuu qabu jedhamee guyyaa sadiif labsame keessa dha. Bakka bu'oonni Ameerikaa waraana kana xumuruuf Moskoo fi Kiyivitti marii kan gaggeessaa jiran yoo ta'u, buufata niwuukilaraa Zaapooriizhiyaa keessatti ibsaa deebisuuf immoo walii galteen dhaabbii lolaa adda ta'e tokko taasifameera.

title: Why is Trump threatening to strike Iran’s Pickaxe Mountain again, now?
english: President Donald Trump has renewed his threats to launch a military strike against Iran's fortified Pickaxe Mountain nuclear facility. This warning follows a recent US missile attack on an Iranian oil tanker near Kharg Island amid ongoing regional tensions. While the administration downplays the severity of the conflict, the lack of progress in nuclear negotiations has kept military risks high.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በኢራን በሚገኘው የፒክአክስ ማውንቴን የኑክሌር ማዕከል ላይ ወታደራዊ ጥቃት እንደሚሰነዝሩ ዳግም አስፈራሩ። ይህ ማስጠንቀቂያ የተሰማው በአካባቢው ውጥረት እየጨመረ ባለበት ወቅት በአሜሪካ ኃይሎች በካርግ ደሴት አቅራቢያ በኢራን የነዳጅ መርከብ ላይ ጥቃት ከተፈጸመ በኋላ ነው። የትራምፕ አስተዳደር ግጭቱን ቀላል ቢመስልም የኑክሌር ድርድር አለመሳካቱ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን የጦርነት ስጋት ከፍ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Doolaard Tiraamp buufata niwukilaraa Iiraan kan ta'e Pickaxe Mountain irratti weerara waraanaa gaggeessuu akka danda'an marakachuu isaanii irra deebin ibsaniiru. Doorsisni kun kan dhufe, yeroo waraanni naannichatti hammaataa jiru kana, markaba boba'aa Iiraan kan ta'e kan ganda Kharg biratti haleelame boodadha. Mootummaan Tiraamp walitti bu'iinsa kana salphisee ilaaluuf yaaluus, mariin niwukilaraa bu'aa dhabuun isaa soda waraanaa kana dabalee jira.

title: US ambassador to Israel meets Palestinian-Americans in occupied West Bank
english: US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee recently traveled to Turmus Ayya in the occupied West Bank. During his visit, he met with local Palestinian-American residents and community leaders. The trip took place against a backdrop of escalating tensions and frequent attacks by Israeli settlers in the region.
amharic: የአሜሪካው አምባሳደር በእስራኤል ማይክ ሀካቢ በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ክፍል ወደምትገኘው ቱርሙስ አያ ከተማ ተጉዘዋል። በጉብኝታቸውም ከአካባቢው የፍልስጤም አሜሪካውያን ነዋሪዎች እና ከኃላፊዎች ጋር ተወያይተዋል። ጉብኝቱ የተካሄደው በአካባቢው እየተባባሰ ባለው የሰፋሪዎች ጥቃት እና ውጥረት መካከል ነው።
oromo: Ambaasaaddarri Ameerikaa gara Israa'el Maayik Haakaabii gara magaalaa Turmus Ayya kan naannoo Waa'ii Bangee (West Bank) qabamee jiruutti imaluudhaan jiraattotaa fi hoogganoota Falasxiim-Ameerikaa waliin mari'ataniiru. Imalli kun kan ta'e yeroo naannicha keessatti haleellaan warra lafa qabatanii jiran irra deddeebi'ee mudachaa jiru fi waldhabdee guddaan jiru kanatti.

title: Ethiopia’s Future Demands Axum–Harar Synergy
english: Ethiopian civilization is defined by the interaction between two major historical centers: the northern Christian highlands of Axum and the eastern Islamic trading hub of Harar. While many diverse ethnic groups have contributed to the country's development, these two regions represent enduring symbols of institutional and cultural history. Recognizing both traditions as complementary pillars is essential to understanding the full complexity of Ethiopia's heritage.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ስልጣኔ በሰሜኑ የአክሱም ክርስቲያናዊ ማዕከል እና በምስራቁ የሐረር እስላማዊ የንግድ ማዕከል መካከል ባለው ግንኙነት የተቃኘ ነው። ብዙ ብሄረሰቦች ለሀገሪቱ እድገት አስተዋጽኦ ቢያደርጉም፣ እነዚህ ሁለት አካባቢዎች የረዥም ጊዜ ታሪካዊ እና ባህላዊ ተቋማት ምልክቶች ናቸው። የሁለቱንም የባህል ስሮች እንደ ሀገር ዋና መሰረት አድርጎ መውሰድ የኢትዮጵያን አጠቃላይ ታሪክ ለመረዳት ወሳኝ ነው።
oromo: Siivilizeeshiniin Itoophiyaa guddinaa fi seenaa isaa keessatti bu’uura Axum fi Harar irratti kan hundaa’e dha. Saboonni fi sab-lammoonni Itoophiyaa hedduun biyya kana ijaaruu keessatti gahee qabaatanis, Axum fi Harar akka mallattoo seenaa fi aadaa cimaatti fudhatamu. Aadaa fi seenaa naannoo lamaan kana walitti fiduun Itoophiyaa fiixaan baatee beekuuf murteessaa dha.

title: Niger accuses France of orchestrating failed military mutiny
english: The military government of Niger has officially accused France of supporting a failed mutiny attempt that took place at an important airbase in the capital city. These allegations follow recent violent confrontations between the ruling junta and soldiers who tried to seize power. This event marks another point of tension between the current administration and the French government.
amharic: የኒጀር ወታደራዊ አስተዳደር ባለፈው ሳምንት በዋና ከተማዋ በሚገኝ ወታደራዊ የአየር ማረፊያ ላይ የተደረገው መፈንቅለ መንግስት ሙከራ ከፈረንሳይ ድጋፍ የተደረገለት እንደሆነ ከሷል። ይህ ክስ የቀረበው የገዢው ጁንታ እና ስልጣን ለመያዝ የሞከሩ ወታደሮች በተጋጩበት ወቅት ነው። ክስተቱ በኒጀር አገዛዝ እና በፈረንሳይ መንግስት መካከል ያለውን ውጥረት አባብሶታል።
oromo: Mootummaan waraanaa biyya Niijer, kutaala magaalaa guddoo ishee keessatti argamu irratti ka'ee ture garuu milkaa'uu hin dandeenye, mootummaa Faransaay qindeessuun akka raawwatame himate. Himannaan kun kan dhufe erga waraanni mootummaa fi loltoonni aangoo irraa buusuu barbaadan walitti bu'anii booda. Ta'een kun hariiroo mootummaa amma aangoorra jiruufi biyya Faransaay gidduu jiru kan caalaatti jabeessu ta'a.

title: Alcaraz, Sabalenka into US Open last 16 as Williams sisters lose on return
english: Defending champions Carlos Alcaraz and Aryna Sabalenka have successfully advanced to the round of 16 at the US Open after winning their respective singles matches. While these stars continued their strong performance in the tournament, tennis legends Serena and Venus Williams faced a difficult loss during their highly anticipated return to doubles competition. Alcaraz is set to play Tommy Paul next, while Sabalenka will face Taylor Townsend in the upcoming round.
amharic: የዩኤስ ኦፕን አሸናፊዎች ካርሎስ አልካራስ እና አሪና ሳባሌንካ በየክፍላቸው ተጋጣሚዎችን በማሸነፍ ወደ ቀጣዩ ዙር አልፈዋል። የቴኒስ ኮከቦች የሆኑት ሴሬና እና ቪነስ ዊሊያምስ ከረጅም ጊዜ በኋላ በጥምረት ወደ ውድድር ቢመለሱም፣ በሚያሳዝን ሁኔታ ሽንፈትን አስተናግደዋል። አልካራስ ቀጥሎ ከቶሚ ፖል ጋር የሚጫወት ሲሆን ሳባሌንካ ደግሞ ከቴይለር ታውንሰንድ ጋር የምትገናኝ ይሆናል።
oromo: Injifattoonni waggaa darbee Kaarlos Alkaaraz fi Ariinaa Saabaaleenkaas tapha gita isaanii injifachuun gara sadarkaa 16ffaa US Open darbeera. Yeroo kanaan taphattoonni beekamoon akkasumas obboloonni Wiiliyaams, Seereenaa fi Viinas, erga waggaa dheeraa booda tapha cimdii irratti deebi'anii hirmaatanii injifatamaniiru. Alkaaraz fuulduratti Toomii Pool waliin kan taphatu yoo ta'u, Saabaaleenkaas ammoo Teeylar Taawunsand waliin kan morkattu ta'a.

title: Have scientists discovered a dark matter particle?
english: Researchers in a South Dakota laboratory have detected a mysterious particle interaction that might finally offer clues about dark matter, the invisible substance believed to hold the universe together. While this finding is not yet a confirmed discovery, it represents a significant step in understanding the vast portion of space that remains unseen. To further explore these hidden cosmic forces, NASA is also preparing to launch a specialized telescope dedicated to studying dark matter and dark energy.
amharic: በደቡብ ዳኮታ የሚገኙ ሳይንቲስቶች አጽናፈ ሰማይን በአንድነት እንደያዘ በሚታመነው 'ጨለማ ቁስ' (dark matter) ላይ ጥናት ሲያደርጉ ያልተለመደ የንጥል እንቅስቃሴ ማግኘታቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ግኝት ገና በይፋ ያልተረጋገጠ ቢሆንም፣ እስከ አሁን ድረስ በምስጢር የተሸፈነውን የአጽናፈ ሰማይ ክፍል ለመረዳት ትልቅ እርምጃ ተደርጎ ተወስዷል። የጨለማ ቁስ እና የጨለማ ጉልበትን ምስጢር ለመፍታት ናሳ ልዩ ቴሌስኮፕ ለመላክ እየተዘጋጀ ይገኛል።
oromo: Qorattoonni lafa jala, kutaa South Dakota, Ameerikaa jiru keessatti, ragaa 'dark matter' ykn meeshaa ifa hin qabne kan addunyaa wal qabsiisu jedhamee yaadamu irratti mallattoo haaraa argatan. Wanti kun ammayyuu guutummaatti mirkanaa'uu baatus, hubannoo keenya kan addunyaa ifaan mul'atuu ala jiruuf tarkaanfii guddaadha. NASA'n guddina kana qorachuufis, telescope addaa kan 'dark matter' fi 'dark energy' irratti xiyyeeffatu erguuf qophaa'aa jira.

title: At least five killed in Sudan’s South Kordofan in attack by rebel group
english: Rebel forces from the SPLM-N have launched artillery attacks on residential areas in Sudan's South Kordofan province, resulting in at least 26 deaths including children. The medical group reporting these incidents warned that the violence is worsening the humanitarian crisis and specifically targeting minority groups in the Nuba Mountains. These assaults continue despite ceasefire efforts, further complicating the ongoing conflict between Sudan's military and paramilitary factions.
amharic: የኤስ.ፒ.ኤል.ኤም-ኤን አማፂ ቡድን በሱዳን ደቡብ ኮርዶፋን ግዛት በሚኖሩ ሰላማዊ ሰዎች ላይ ባደረሰው የከባድ መሳሪያ ጥቃት ቢያንስ 26 ሰዎች መሞታቸውን የህክምና ባለሙያዎች አስታወቁ። በጥቃቱ ህፃናትን ጨምሮ ንፁሃን መገደላቸው እና የተፈናቀሉ ሰዎች ቁጥር መጨመሩ የሰብአዊ ቀውሱን ይበልጥ እንዳባባሰው ተገልጿል። ይህ ጥቃት በሀገሪቱ እየተካሄደ ካለው የርስ በርስ ጦርነት ጎን ለጎን የዘር ግጭትንም በማስከተል ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Humni finxaaleyyiin SPLM-N jedhamu naannoo Kordofaanii Kibbaa Sudaanitti namoota nagaa irratti haleellaa raawwateen lubbuun namoota 26 ol darbeera. Gareen ogeeyyii fayyaa akka ibsetti, haleellaan kun daran baay'ee fi miidhaa guddaa geessisuun isaa rakkoo namoomaa biyyattii keessatti babal'atee jiru daran hammaachiseera. Haleellaan kun gamtaan dhaabbata biyyoota gamtoomaniis ta'e carraaqqiin tasgabii biyyattii keessatti taasifamaa jiru osoo jiruu kan raawwatame yoo ta'u, gidduu galeessatti sanyii irratti xiyyeeffate ta'uunis himameera.

title: Bolivian military barracks explosion kills at least 10
english: A tragic explosion occurred at a military base in Viacha, Bolivia, resulting in at least 10 fatalities. The blast was caused by a cache of fireworks and pyrotechnics stored at the facility. Numerous other people were left injured following the incident.
amharic: ቦሊቪያ በሚገኘው የቪያቻ ወታደራዊ ካምፕ ውስጥ በተከሰተ የፍንዳታ አደጋ ቢያንስ 10 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ፍንዳታው በካምፑ ውስጥ ተከማችተው በነበሩ ርችቶች እና ተያያዥ ቁሳቁሶች ምክንያት የተፈጠረ ነው። በዚህ አደጋ ምክንያት በርካታ ሰዎችም ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል።
oromo: Buufata waraanaa Viacha, Boliviyaa keessatti balaa dhohuu mudateen namoonni yoo xiqqaate 10 du’aniiru. Dhohiinsi kun meeshaalee ibiddaa (fireworks) buufatichatti kuufamanii turan irraa kan madde dha. Balaa kanaan namoonni hedduun ammoo miidhamaniiru.

title: UN says Israeli settler violence in West Bank displaced 2,500 Palestinians in 2026
english: The United Nations reports that settler violence in the occupied West Bank has forced 2,500 Palestinians to abandon their homes this year, with children accounting for half of those affected. Since 2023, these attacks and movement restrictions have displaced over 6,400 people and completely emptied dozens of Palestinian communities. Aid groups warn that this ongoing trend is causing a worsening humanitarian crisis due to the destruction of property and loss of access to essential services.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት በምዕራብ ባንክ በሚኖሩ እስራኤላዊ ሰፋሪዎች የሚፈጸም ጥቃት በዘንድሮው ዓመት ብቻ 2,500 ፍልስጤማውያንን ከመኖሪያቸው እንዳፈናቀለ ገልጿል፤ ከተፈናቃዮቹ መካከል ግማሾቹ ህጻናት ናቸው። ከ2023 ጀምሮ በተከሰቱ ተመሳሳይ ጥቃቶች እና የመንቀሳቀስ ገደቦች ከ6,400 በላይ ሰዎች መፈናቀላቸውን እና በርካታ መንደሮች ባዶ እንደቀሩ ተጠቁሟል። የሰብአዊ መብት ተቋማት ይህ ተደጋጋሚ ጥቃት እና የመሠረተ ልማት ውድመት በአካባቢው የከፋ የሰብአዊ ቀውስ እየፈጠረ መሆኑን አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii akka gabaasetti, weerara naannawaa Lixa Baankiitti raawwatameen bara kana qofa namoonni Pilaasxiin 2,500 ta'an qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqa'aniiru; isaan keessaa walakkaan isaanii ijoollee dha. Bara 2023 irraa eegalee, weerara kanaafi uggura sochii kanaan walqabatee namoonni 6,400 ol ta'an buqqa'anii, gandoonni Pilaasxiin hedduun guutummaatti duwwaa ta'aniiru. Gareewwan gargaarsaa akka jedhanitti, haleellaan kun fi mancaatiin qabeenyaa, namoota irratti miidhaa hamaa qaqqabsiisuun rakkoo namoomaa daran hammaataa akka jiru akeekkachisaniiru.

title: 55 bodies, remains of Malka family recovered from rubble in Gaza's Zeytoun
english: Rescue teams in Gaza City's Zeytoun neighborhood recently discovered the bodies of 55 members of the Malka family trapped under building wreckage. These individuals had been missing since they sought shelter in the structure during an Israeli bombardment two years ago. Authorities plan to hold a collective funeral for the victims early next week.
amharic: በጋዛ ከተማ ዘይቱን አካባቢ የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች ከፈራረሰው ህንጻ ስር የ55 የማልካ ቤተሰብ አባላትን አስከሬን አግኝተዋል። እነዚህ ሰዎች ከሁለት አመት በፊት በእስራኤል የቦምብ ጥቃት ወቅት መጠለያ ፍለጋ ወደ ህንጻው ገብተው እንደነበር ተገልጿል። ለሟቾች የቀብር ስነ ስርዓት በሚቀጥለው ሳምንት መጀመሪያ ላይ በጋራ እንደሚፈጸም ባለስልጣናት አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Magaala Gaaza keessatti gareewwan gargaarsa namoomaa reeffa miseensota maatii Malka 55 ta'an, iddoo ijaarsi tokko caccabe jala irraa argataniiru. Namoonni kunneen waggoota lama dura yeroo haleellaan rooba boombii geggeeffame sana baqachuuf gara ijaarsichaa seenanii turan. Qaamoleen aango qaban immoo, torbee dhufu jalqaba irratti reeffa namoota kanaaf sirni awwaalchaa waloo akka godhamu beeksisaniiru.

title: Morning recap
english: Tensions in the Middle East have escalated as Iran threatens preemptive action against perceived threats, while Western powers push for a UN Security Council resolution regarding Iran's nuclear activities. Meanwhile, Israeli airstrikes in Lebanon resulted in several casualties, and the U.S. approved a multi-billion dollar arms sale to Saudi Arabia. Additionally, regional maritime traffic has significantly declined, and internal security investigations are underway within the U.S. military regarding information leaks.
amharic: በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ያለው ውጥረት እየተባባሰ በመምጣቱ ኢራን በራሷ ላይ ስጋት የሆኑ ነገሮች ሲያጋጥሙ አስቀድማ እንደምትወስድ አስታውቃለች፤ ምዕራባውያን ሀገራትም የኢራንን የኑክሌር እንቅስቃሴ ለተባበሩት መንግስታት የጸጥታው ምክር ቤት ለማቅረብ እየሰሩ ነው። በሌላ በኩል እስራኤል በሊባኖስ ባደረሰችው ጥቃት የሰው ህይወት የጠፋ ሲሆን አሜሪካም ለሳውዲ አረቢያ የጦር መሳሪያ ለመሸጥ ተስማምታለች። ከዚህም በተጨማሪ በሆርሙዝ የባህር ወሽመጥ የሚደረገው የመርከብ ጉዞ በግማሽ ቀንሷል፤ በአሜሪካ ጦር ውስጥም ስለ ጦርነቱ መረጃ መፍሰስን ተከትሎ ምርመራዎች እየተካሄዱ ይገኛል።
oromo: Giddugaleessa Bahaatti waraanniifi waldhabdeen dabaluu isaa hordofee, Iraan sodaachisa kamiyyuu dura dhaabbachuuf tarkaanfii fudhachuuf akka qophoofte ibsiteetti; biyyoonni lixaa immoo waa'ee hojii niwukilaaraa Iraan irratti gabaasa gara Mana Maree Nageenyaa Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomaniitti ergachuuf yaalii gochaa jiru. Gammachuu biraatiin, haleellaan Israa'el Libaanoos irratti raawwatte lubbuu namaa galaafateera, akkasumas Ameerikaan Sa'udii Arabiyaaf meeshaa waraanaa gurguruuf waliigaltee mallatteessiteetti. Kana malees, daandii galaana Hormuz irratti sochiin doonii hir'achuu isaa fi waraana Ameerikaa keessatti oduu icciitii ta'e baasuun walqabatee qorannoon gaggeeffamaa jiraachuun ibsameera.
